selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the main idea of this passage?
questions.answer: Things that may look ugly or harsh on the outside can still contain real beauty, wisdom, and order.

questions.question: What is relative beauty?
questions.answer: It is beauty seen through the results and outcomes of something.

questions.question: What hidden kindness is connected to autumn’s losses?
questions.answer: Small creatures are relieved from life’s duties before winter’s harshness.

questions.question: Which difficult events are named as examples of hidden good?
questions.answer: Storms, earthquakes, and plague.

questions.question: What happens to hidden abilities in times of hardship?
questions.answer: They begin to sprout and develop.

questions.question: What is the problem with judging by only the side that affects us?
questions.answer: It ignores many other wise purposes in creation.

questions.question: What example shows that something apparently harsh can help another creature improve?
questions.answer: Hawks chasing sparrows, because it helps the sparrows’ abilities develop.

questions.question: Why do some people call certain matters shameful too quickly?
questions.answer: Because they only think about how those matters look in front of people.

questions.question: What does the passage imply about wisdom-based reading of difficult subjects?
questions.answer: It helps a person see what is proper and meaningful instead of reacting only emotionally.

questions.question: What does the passage say about many things that appear mixed up or irregular?
questions.answer: They are actually organized and meaningful in reality.

questions.question: What truth about all created things is explained in this passage?
questions.answer: Every created thing has some form of beauty, even if people do not notice it at first.

questions.question: What is one reason people fail to see beauty in difficult things?
questions.answer: They stop at the outer appearance.

questions.question: What hidden good is connected with the end of some animals’ lives in autumn?
questions.answer: They are protected from suffering during winter.

questions.question: Why is winter mentioned after autumn’s losses?
questions.answer: To show what those creatures are being protected from and how spring is being prepared.

questions.question: What does the passage say these severe events can help reveal?
questions.answer: Hidden potentials and spiritual beauties.

questions.question: According to the passage, if one aim of an event relates to human beings, how many may relate to Allah’s names?
questions.answer: Thousands.

questions.question: What lesson is taught by the example of hawks and sparrows?
questions.answer: A difficult or harsh situation can still lead to growth and benefit.

questions.question: What error comes from “worshipping the apparent,” as described here?
questions.answer: A person judges only by what is outward and misses deeper truth.

questions.question: How is the Qur’an described in relation to manners and right conduct?
questions.answer: It is presented as a source of true politeness and proper behavior.

questions.question: How does the passage reinterpret apparent disorder?
questions.answer: As a kind of real order and meaningful writing.

questions.question: According to the passage, does ugliness always mean something is truly bad?
questions.answer: No, something may look ugly while still containing beauty and wisdom.

questions.question: What is the difference between the two kinds of beauty mentioned?
questions.answer: One belongs directly to the thing itself, and the other appears in what it produces.

questions.question: How do rain and mud in spring help the reader understand the main point?
questions.answer: They seem unattractive, but they lead to beautiful flowers and organized plant growth.

questions.question: What larger cycle of seasons helps explain the passage’s argument?
questions.answer: The movement from autumn and winter to a renewed spring.

title: 2 Point True Beauty in Everything and Wisdom Behind the Veil
